_comment: STILL image generation (profile headshots, classroom stills).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: medium-tall, solid and composed, unhurried movement

face: square face with a broad forehead, calm observant dark eyes behind rectangular glasses, neat short beard fully greying at the chin, medium-deep brown skin, faint frown line between the brows
hair: short neat natural hair, greying at the temples

wardrobe.teaching: olive or brown jacket with elbow patches over a checked shirt, corduroy trousers, sturdy shoes
alternates: shirt and knitted tie without the jacket
field gilet over the shirt for outdoor stills

presence.posture: stands beside the map, tracing a contour with the ruler; measured turns, deliberate pauses
presence.default_expression: thoughtful and precise, the settled focus of someone reading landscape like text

environment: classroom wall of maps and aerial photographs, contour map spread on the bench, daylight from the side
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 44-52 year old Black South African male teacher. square face with a broad forehead, calm observant dark eyes behind rectangular glasses, neat short beard fully greying at the chin, medium-deep brown skin, faint frown line between the brows. Hair: short neat natural hair, greying at the temples. Wearing olive or brown jacket with elbow patches over a checked shirt, corduroy trousers, sturdy shoes. rectangular dark-framed glasses. Expression: thoughtful and precise, the settled focus of someone reading landscape like text. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, grey seamless or softly blurred classroom background. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.
prompts.classroom: A 44-52 year old Black South African male teacher mid-lesson in a South African school. medium-tall, solid and composed, unhurried movement. square face with a broad forehead, calm observant dark eyes behind rectangular glasses, neat short beard fully greying at the chin, medium-deep brown skin, faint frown line between the brows. Hair: short neat natural hair, greying at the temples. Wearing olive or brown jacket with elbow patches over a checked shirt, corduroy trousers, sturdy shoes. Holding/using: rectangular dark-framed glasses, rolled 1:50 000 topographic map. Posture: stands beside the map, tracing a contour with the ruler; measured turns, deliberate pauses. Expression: thoughtful and precise, the settled focus of someone reading landscape like text. Setting: classroom wall of maps and aerial photographs, contour map spread on the bench, daylight from the side. practical daylight from classroom windows plus soft fill; avoid flat overhead fluorescent. full-frame, 35mm f/2.8 for context or 50mm f/2 for waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, American classroom props, chalkboard gibberish, unreadable equations, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, grey seamless or softly blurred classroom background
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

classroom.camera: full-frame, 35mm f/2.8 for context or 50mm f/2 for waist-up
classroom.lighting: practical daylight from classroom windows plus soft fill; avoid flat overhead fluorescent
classroom.framing: waist-up with the board visible over the shoulder, or wider three-quarter with the tutor mid-gesture
